toggle.description: Native encrypted offline mail cache (SQLCipher) + windowed sync. DEFAULT OFF — enable/Work-Offline UI also gates on caps.offline.allowed (owned by #2a) AND a native shell (isOfflineAvailable), inert until then. Browser is online-only.
